facts.activity_file: making up, decanting and dosing reagents

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

restraint and placarding of transported loads

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: loss of containment at P-8304 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-8304, M-8304 and PT-8304 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically making up, decanting and dosing reagents. P-8304 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 April 2010 an incident occurred on P-8304, M-8304 and PT-8304 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
